svg.title: Figure 6-1 · Fault-injection coverage
svg.desc: Matrix of the 32 fault-injection cases VS-FI-01 to VS-FI-32, grouped by §5.1 to §5.6. For each case: injection levels, the TSR blocks 1xx to 8xx its mechanism names (with counts), the safety goals SG-01 to SG-07 reached through the parent FSRs, whether a §6 analysis item names it, the WP-W-02 implementation status, and the §8 result, which is 'not yet executed' for every case. Below, the 14 §6 analysis items from WP-A-04, WP-A-02 and WP-A-03 with their cases; SPF-01 is not testable by fault injection and eight System FMEA causes from WP-A-04 v0.2 have no case yet.
svg.text: The 32 fault-injection cases of §5 against the TSR blocks and safety goals their mechanisms serve, and the §6 analysis items they cover. Specification only: nothing has been executed.
